Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité, Metallica! ("Liberty, Equality, Fraternity, Metallica!") is a live album by Metallica. It was recorded at Le Bataclan in Paris, France and released on April 15, 2016.

page.overview:
What is Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité, Metallica!?

Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité, Metallica! ("Liberty, Equality, Fraternity, Metallica!") is a live album by Metallica. It was recorded at Le Bataclan in Paris, France and released on April 15, 2016.
